1. Company Return and Refund Policy
GlobalTech offers a comprehensive 30-day money-back guarantee for all hardware and packaged
software products. If a customer is not completely satisfied with their purchase: 
Items must be returned in their original packaging with all included accessories.
Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the
returned item arrives at the fulfillment center.

2. Product Warranty and Repair Coverage
Every hardware unit manufactured by GlobalTech comes with a 1-Year Limited Standard Warranty
covering manufacturing defects and internal component failures. 
Warranty Claims Process: Customers must open a support ticket on the portal and provide proof
of purchase with serial number. If hardware diagnostics confirm a defect, a replacement device
will be dispatched within 48 hours via express courier.

The standard warranty does NOT cover physical drops, water intrusion, unauthorized hardware

3. Work From Home (WFH) and Remote Work Guidelines
Employees are permitted to work remotely up to 3 days per week under the hybrid workplace policy,
subject to manager approval. 
Internet Reimbursement: A monthly internet allowance of $60 is provided to all active full-time
staff.
Working Hours: Core collaboration hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Time.

4. Annual Leave and Medical Benefits
Full-time employees receive 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per calendar year, accrued monthly. In
addition: 
Employees are granted 10 dedicated paid sick days per year without requiring a medical certificate
for absences under 3 consecutive days.
